orders.text:
MCC No. 1532/2018 (Restoration Application) 
In 
WPSS No. 2005 of 2014 
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, Advocate for the 
petitioner. 
Mrs. Seema Sah, Brief Holder for the 
State of Uttarakhand. 
Mr. B.S. Adhikari, Advocate for 
respondent no. 4. 
Mr. Sandeep Tiwari, Advocate for 
respondent no. 5. 
Heard learned counsel for the parties on 
the restoration application. The same is not 
being opposed. 
The petitioner has reasonably explained 
the reasons for absence on the date of hearing. 
Consequently, the restoration application is 
allowed. The Writ Petition is restored to its 
original number along with the interim order, if 
any. 
List this case after winter vacations for 
final hearing. 
In the meantime, in case if the private 
respondents, so desires, he may file 
supplementary counter affidavit. 
 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) 
 14.12.2018 
Pooja
